summary: Milestone 2026.09.655 completed 13 experiments, all compute-bound, in 91.3 wall-time minutes. 'Measure exclusive live ARC decision cost on sealed panel A' was the dominant critical path at 56.85 minutes, followed by 'Capture Qwen internal-test, online and external source-option rows' at 10.14 minutes and 'Capture Qwen training and calibration source-option rows' at 8.66 minutes. Intra-task phase timing was not recorded in the milestone data to isolate specific execution bottlenecks within these runs.
bottlenecks_identified: 'Measure exclusive live ARC decision cost on sealed panel A' consumed 56.85 out of 91.3 minutes (over 62% of milestone wall time), but sub-phase timing was not recorded, leaving internal evaluation bottlenecks unisolated.

The remaining 12 compute-bound tasks totaled approximately 34.45 minutes, led by Qwen source-option row capture (10.14 minutes and 8.66 minutes) and reduction (7.84 minutes), with timestamps reconstructed from disk mtimes rather than continuous stage logs.
The GPU monitor report provides an end-of-run snapshot (0% utilization, 4MB allocated) after execution completed rather than continuous per-task telemetry across active compute intervals.
Experiment launch records omit model concurrency and runner dispatch details, preventing verification of whether any multi-model workload qualified for DualGPURunner.
improvements_suggested: Instrument fine-grained sub-phase monotonic timers and iteration logging within live ARC decision evaluation to separate inference duration from environment and harness overhead.
Deploy task-scoped continuous accelerator telemetry to record GPU utilization percentage and VRAM occupancy across active compute execution spans.
Log concurrent model counts and runner selection at job launch, verifying DualGPURunner engagement whenever two or more models execute simultaneously.
Implement bounded iteration or early-stagnation checkpoints for long-running ARC decision tasks.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument fine-grained phase timers and iteration telemetry in the live ARC decision cost evaluation harness.
Deploy continuous, task-aligned accelerator telemetry to sample GPU utilization across active compute execution intervals.
Record model concurrency and runner dispatch at job initiation, verifying DualGPURunner usage for workloads running two or more models in parallel.
meta_reflection: The milestone critical path is clearly concentrated in the 56.85-minute live ARC decision cost measurement, but absent sub-phase telemetry prevents causal diagnosis of internal delays. A post-run GPU snapshot cannot evaluate active compute-window efficiency, and without multi-model logging, no DualGPURunner omission can be confirmed.
